dedupe_keys.name: airesq thermal person detector training scripts

description: The AIResQ team archives basic Python training scripts for thermal person detectors used with its drone image data. The Zenodo record declares LGPL 3.0 and lists a code archive. The article names configurations for YOLOv8, YOLO11, RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN and RT-DETR; the linked GitHub repository also declares LGPL 3.0. Source is free to access. Coverage follows the AIResQ labelled thermal scenes, not an installed emergency-service detector. The scripts can help compare detection models before emergency-response simulations of aerial-search operations. A caveat is that the deposit is training code, not a validated trained model or proof of real-time deployment. Software versions, data split and image resolution can materially change results. The own Zenodo and GitHub metadata were inspected without downloading the archive, installing dependencies or measuring field accuracy. The full imagery and benchmark have separate Zenodo records; no directly related catalogue model was identified.
